post.summary: Visual Inspection Against Approved Organizational Assets
post.description:
Inspects embedded raster images in submitted PDF/DOCX or direct image files
and compares them strictly against the organization's catalog of approved brand assets.
Flags:
- UNAPPROVED_ASSET: Image not in approved catalog.
- STRETCHED_OR_DISTORTED: Approved logo with distorted aspect ratio.
- OUTDATED_LOGO: Matches an approved asset marked is_deprecated or expired.
- APPROVED_MATCH: Fully compliant approved asset.

Allows the Creator to ACCEPT, REJECT, or EDIT a finding correction:
- Never overwrites the original submission snapshot.
- If accepted or edited: computes a new immutable DocumentRevision node (vN+1),
  recalculates character offsets and AST span map, computes unified diff,
  and transitions submission to IN_CREATOR_REVISION.
- Emits immutable records to the audit ledger.

post.summary: Submit Revised Content for Human Compliance Review
post.description:
Transitions submission from IN_CREATOR_REVISION to IN_HUMAN_REVIEW.
Ensures legal state transition via the strict finite state machine.

Executes certified human compliance reviewer determination (APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED):
- Guarantees AI cannot approve: requires authenticated REVIEWER or ADMINISTRATOR role.
- Anti-Rubber-Stamping: Requires explicit verification for findings flagged by the
  Automation-Bias Safeguard (is_automation_bias_audit=True) before approval can be granted.
- Records inline comments and conditional approval stipulations.
- Cryptographically logs REVIEW_DECIDED in the audit ledger.

post.description:
Ingests raw text or Markdown, normalizes Unicode (NFC), parses offset-preserving
AST span map, establishes Genesis revision #1 (v1), and commits event to audit ledger.

Uploads and verifies document binary assets (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD):
1. Enforces magic byte verification (rejects spoofed extensions).
2. Scans for active VBA macros, executable streams, and XML/zip bombs.
3. Tokenizes document into offset-preserved AST nodes (bboxes for PDF, styles for DOCX).
4. Commits Submission and Genesis Revision (v1) with SHA-256 integrity hash.
5. Appends cryptographic audit entry to audit_ledger.
Creates a submission from structured payload establishes Genesis revision (v1).

get.summary: Real-time SSE Streaming of 4-Stage Intelligence Pipeline
get.description:
Streams Server-Sent Events (SSE) representing real-time pipeline execution stages
with millisecond latencies to the React frontend dashboard:
- STAGE_1_DETERMINISTIC_COMPLETE
- STAGE_2_TEMPORAL_FACT_RAG_COMPLETE
- STAGE_3_PRIVACY_GATE_VERIFIED
- STAGE_4_TRIAGE_COMPLETE
- PIPELINE_COMPLETE

post.description:
Executes the 4-stage intelligence pipeline on an immutable document revision:
1. Deterministic Rule Engine (O(N) Aho-Corasick, Readability, Passive Voice, Caps Abuse).
2. Temporal Fact & Hybrid RAG Retrieval Engine (RRF, Staleness, Missing Evidence).
3. Zero-Trust Privacy Gate & Circuit-Breaker LLM Router (PII Scrubber, Cache).
4. Calibrated Confidence Triage & 15% Stochastic Automation-Bias Safeguard.

get.summary: Governance Compliance Metrics & Severity CUBE Report
get.description:
Executes single-pass PostgreSQL aggregations (GROUP BY CUBE / CTEs) so reported
issue-category counts (TONE, TERMINOLOGY, MESSAGING, STALE_FACT, UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM, ACCESSIBILITY)
and severity distributions mathematically match underlying findings records with 100% precision.

Computes the exact percentage of findings that possess a valid, non-null supporting
linked_guideline_id or linked_fact_id reference, proving zero ungrounded violation claims.

post.summary: Execute Automated Labelled Test Set Benchmark Evaluation
post.description:
Executes the analysis pipeline against a built-in labelled evaluation dataset
containing 15 realistic corporate content samples with known ground-truth violations
(outdated statistics, unapproved superlatives, off-brand tone, terminology conflicts,
and clean baseline passages).
Computes True Positives, False Positives, False Negatives, Precision, Recall, F1 Score, and P95 latency.

Limited-Retention TTL Reaper:
Scans for submissions older than brand retention policy (e.g. 30 days).
Cryptographically shreds raw text while preserving finding counts and audit logs.
Records RETENTION_POLICY_PURGED events in the cryptographic ledger.
